description: Illuminate local spans of the moving weave to discover source paths, then track its contact servos without burning the loom.

metadata.variant_count_kind: woven permutations, independent smooth motion, target ribbon, depths and servo response

name: Ribbon Switchboard V3 · Difficulty 1 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Hover over the weave to illuminate local spans and discover the marked source ribbon through its crossings. Inspected spans stay lit; you can inspect safely before energizing. Energize the loom. Drag each ivory servo knob vertically to keep its advancing contact inside the glowing band of the marked source ribbon. All ribbons move continuously during the run, including inspection, and a full visible HEAT bar ends the attempt. Keep every contact connected through the entire braid. Faint echoes show the last 0.8 seconds.
